  let n := t+1

  let K := Fin (4*n)

      (∀ v, p v = none ∨ p v = some (x v)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i))).card = r.val ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i+1))).card = b.val)).card
  let raw := fun (x : V → Bool) => List.ofFn (fun i : I => x (false,i)) ++ List.ofFn (fun i : I => x (true,i))
  let val := fun (z : K → Bool) => ∑ k : K, (z k).toNat * 2^k.val
  let inputs := 2+(n+1)*(n+1)*(2*n+1)+8*n
  ∃ (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (num ord : K → Fin (inputs+g.size))

    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs g ∧ g.size ≤ (n+2)^C ∧

changed.title: Fixed pooled pin-count experiments recover sparse hidden graphs with errors and erasures up to a sharp limiting distance
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t k : ℕ, 2 ≤ t →
  let T := Fin t
  let V := Option (T × Bool)
  let Pair := {p : T × T // p.1 < p.2}
  let E := Fin 3 × T
  let Mask := T → Fin 3
  let tail := fun e : E => if e.1 = 0 then some (e.2,false) else (none : V)
  let head := fun e : E => some (e.2,decide (e.1 ≠ 1))
  let weight := fun (g : Option Pair) (e : E) (diff : Bool) =>
    if e.1 = 0 then diff.toNat else if e.1 = 2 then 1 else
    if g.elim false (fun p => decide (p.val.1 = e.2 ∨ p.val.2 = e.2)) then
      (if diff then 1 else 3) else (2 : ℕ)
  let obs := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    ∑ x : V → Bool, if (∀ i : T, p i = 0 ∨ p i = (if x (some (i,false)) then 2 else 1)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : E => x (tail e) ≠ x (head e))).card = 2*t then
      ∏ e : E, weight g e (xor (x (tail e)) (x (head e))) else 0
  let Pool := Finset Pair
  let family := (Finset.univ : Finset Pool).filter (fun G => G.card ≤ k)
  let read := fun (G : Pool) (p : Mask) =>
    (obs none p)^(k-G.card) * ∏ e ∈ G, obs (some e) p
  let supp := fun (i : T) (j : Option T) => insert i (j.elim (∅ : Finset T) (fun v => ({v} : Finset T)))
  let factor := fun (x : T → ℤ) (i : T) (j : Option T) => x i - j.elim 0 x
  let poly := fun (G : Pool) (x : T → ℤ) => ∑ e ∈ G, x e.val.1 * x e.val.2
  let simple := fun (G H : Pool) => ∃ (c : ℤ) (i j : T) (v w : Option T),
    c ≠ 0 ∧ v ≠ some i ∧ w ≠ some j ∧ Disjoint (supp i v) (supp j w) ∧
    ∀ x : T → ℤ, poly G x - poly H x = c * factor x i v * factor x j w
  (∀ G ∈ family, ∀ p : Mask,
    let plus := (G.filter (fun e => p e.val.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p e.val.2 ≠ 0 ∧ p e.val.1 = p e.val.2)).card
    let minus := (G.filter (fun e => p e.val.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p e.val.2 ≠ 0 ∧ p e.val.1 ≠ p e.val.2)).card
    4^(plus+minus) * read G p = (obs none p)^k * 5^plus * 3^minus) ∧
  (∀ s : ℕ, 3 ≤ s →
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (batch : Fin d → Mask) (decode : (Fin d → Option ℕ) → Pool),
      0 < d ∧ d ≤ C*s^2*(Nat.log 2 family.card+1) ∧
      (∀ G ∈ family, ∀ H ∈ family, G ≠ H →
        let dist := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d)).filter (fun i =>
          read G (batch i) ≠ read H (batch i))).card
        (4*s-9)*d ≤ 9*s*dist ∧ (¬simple G H → (37*s-81)*d ≤ 81*s*dist)) ∧
      ∀ G ∈ family, ∀ y : Fin d → Option ℕ,
        let erasures := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin d => y i = none)).card
        let errors := (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin d => y i ≠ none ∧
          y i ≠ some (read G (batch i)))).card
        9*s*(2*errors+erasures) < (4*s-9)*d → decode y = G) ∧
  (4 ≤ t → 2 ≤ k → ∀ (d : ℕ) (batch : Fin d → Mask),
    ∃ G ∈ family, ∃ H ∈ family, G ≠ H ∧ G.card = 2 ∧ H.card = 2 ∧
      9*t*((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin d)).filter
        (fun i => read G (batch i) ≠ read H (batch i))).card ≤ (4*t+54)*d)

changed.title: The four-uniform winning-pairing language is NP-complete on binary strings with one canonical accepting witness per hitting matching
changed.statement:
let bits := fun (w v : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun j => v.testBit j)
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let width := fun n : Nat => n.log2+1
let pack := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) =>
  header k ++ rows.flatMap (fun row => row.flatMap (bits (width k)))
let well := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) => ∀ row ∈ rows,
  row.length = 4 ∧ row.Nodup ∧ ∀ v ∈ row, v < k
let wins := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) (P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) =>
  Function.Involutive P ∧ ∀ row ∈ rows, ∃ u : Fin k, u.val ∈ row ∧
    (P u).val ∈ row ∧ P u ≠ u
let lang : Language Bool := {x | ∃ k rows, well k rows ∧ pack k rows = x ∧
  ∃ P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), wins k rows P}
let witness := fun (k : Nat) (P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) =>
  (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => bits (width k) (P i).val)
let R : Set (List Bool × List Bool) := {z | ∃ k rows, well k rows ∧ pack k rows = z.1 ∧
  ∃ P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), wins k rows P ∧ witness k P = z.2}
PEqualNP.Library.NPComplete lang ∧ PEqualNP.Library.PolyTimeReducible PEqualNP.Search.SAT lang ∧
  PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R ∧
  (∀ x w, (x,w) ∈ R → w.length ≤ (x.length+1)^2) ∧
  (∀ k rows, well k rows → ∃ E : {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) // wins k rows P} ≃
    {w : List Bool // (pack k rows,w) ∈ R}, ∀ P, (E P).val = witness k P.val)

    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N+h) C ∧ C.output < N+N+h+C.size ∧
